steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: This may be the most important step: we talk about what you need, the occasion, the style you want and the fabric you would like. You bring the inspiration, and we are here to turn it into reality.

steps.title: Measurements and design
steps.text: We take precise measurements and settle every detail: cut, fabric, lining, buttons, pockets. Nothing is left to guesswork.

steps.title: Making
steps.text: We cut and sew by hand and by machine, paying attention to every seam and every finish.

steps.title: Fitting and delivery
steps.text: At the end we check that everything turned out the way you imagined and whether a few more adjustments are needed.
